UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile storing display name, role, WhatsApp phone number, and Spotify email.

phone.description: WhatsApp phone digits with country code

spotifyEmail.description: Email address assigned to the user's Spotify account

PlanConfig.title: PlanConfig
PlanConfig.description: Global Spotify Family plan settings including fixed monthly LKR amount and bank transfer details.

planName.description: Display name of the shared subscription

monthlyAmountLkr.description: Fixed rounded monthly amount per member in LKR

allowedEmails.description: Lowercase emails of whitelisted members and admin

bankAccountNumber.description: Bank account number for monthly transfer

pinnedAnnouncement.description: Optional admin-pinned notice shown at the top of the Board

pinnedAnnouncements.description: Rotating slideshow list of admin-pinned announcements (up to 8 slides)

WhitelistMember.title: WhitelistMember
WhitelistMember.description: Admin-managed whitelisted friend roster with WhatsApp contact number and reported Spotify email.

spotifyEmail.description: Email address assigned to the friend's Spotify account

familyGroup.description: Assigned Spotify Family group ID (e.g. group_1, group_2, or custom group ID)

active.description: Whether friend is active in current plan

PaymentMonth.title: PaymentMonth
PaymentMonth.description: Monthly billing cycle header identified by YYYY-MM.

amountLkr.description: Fixed LKR amount per member for this cycle

allowedEmails.description: Lowercase emails authorized to view this month

createdByUid.description: Admin UID that generated this month

MemberPaymentStatus.title: MemberPaymentStatus
MemberPaymentStatus.description: Peer-visible monthly payment status for a single member.

memberEmail.description: Lowercase member email for self-update checks

familyGroup.description: Assigned Spotify Family group ID (e.g. group_1, group_2, or custom group ID)

paidAmountLkr.description: Partial or full LKR amount received so far

paymentMethod.description: Payment collection method (e.g. cash in hand vs bank slip)

hasReceipt.description: True if a receipt image has been uploaded

allowedEmails.description: Denormalized authorized emails for list alignment

createdAt.description: Billing start timestamp (used for 7-day overdue check)

ReceiptSlip.title: ReceiptSlip
ReceiptSlip.description: Private compressed payment receipt slip readable by the uploader and Admin.

memberEmail.description: Lowercase email of the member who owes payment

AccessRequest.title: AccessRequest
AccessRequest.description: Pending membership approval request submitted automatically when a new user signs in with Google.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requester

ListeningStat.title: ListeningStat
ListeningStat.description: Monthly Spotify listening summary synced by each connected member for the Leaderboard.

minutesListened.description: Accumulated listening minutes tracked in this month

allowedEmails.description: Authorized lowercase emails for list alignment

FamilyGroup.title: FamilyGroup
FamilyGroup.description: Admin-managed Spotify Family plan group with custom name, starting date, per-member LKR split, slot capacity, theme color, and member-visible Spotify setup details.

groupId.description: Unique group identifier (e.g. group_1, group_2, grp_xxxx)

name.description: Custom display name of the Family Group

startDate.description: Optional subscription starting date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amountLkr.description: Per-member monthly split amount in LKR for this group

maxSlots.description: Maximum member slots for this family plan (default 6)

address.description: Spotify Family Home Address assigned to this group for member verification

managerName.description: Spotify Family Manager display name or profile handle

managerEmail.description: Spotify Family Manager email or contact identifier

inviteLink.description: Optional Spotify Family invite URL for assigned members

notes.description: Optional setup instructions or notes shown to assigned members

/users/{userId}.description: User profile documents keyed by Firebase UID.

/access_requests/{userId}.description: Membership approval requests keyed by requester Firebase UID.

/family_groups/{groupId}.description: Dynamic Spotify Family plan groups managed by Admin.

/whitelist/{memberKey}.description: Approved family members with WhatsApp numbers managed by Admin.

/payments/{monthId}.description: Monthly payment archive documents keyed by YYYY-MM.

/payments/{monthId}/members/{memberKey}.description: Peer-visible member payment status entries within a billing month.

/payments/{monthId}/members/{memberKey}/.description: Private compressed payment receipt slip document (slip).

/payments/{monthId}/stats/{memberKey}.description: Peer-visible Spotify listening stats per member for the monthly Leaderboard.
